column3: Bind area metatile pointers, select the stage layout, then decode it.\nIn: Z_4B area. Uses Z_4C and Z_49 inside PICK_STAGE_LAYOUT.\nOut: Z_62/Z_64/Z_66 point at this area. Falls into DECODE_LAYOUT, which jumps to L7_CF6F.

Decode a layout blob into the nametable and, for rows 0-12, the live map.\nIn: Z_20 layout, Z_62 4-byte tiles, Z_64 map bytes, Z_66 packed attributes.\n32 strips. Each strip offset is added to Z_20. Then jumps to L7_CF6F.
Unpack 8 metatile ids into W_04D1,X.\nA header bit of 1 reads the next byte; a 0 stores 0. X advances. Y is the read index.

Paint 15 cells of one strip.\nMap column is Z_1C. Map row is the cell index minus 2, and COPY_LAYOUT_CELL drops rows past 12.\nTile id indexes Z_62 by 4 and Z_66 as a 2-bit attribute. Columns below 15 call QUEUE_TILE.

Seal a few cells, scatter soft blocks, place bomb pickups, load enemies, then unseal.\nIn: Z_4B, Z_4C, Z_49. Soft-block count comes from SOFT_BLOCK_QUOTA, or 32h when Z_49 is not 0.\nEmpty cells are map byte 0. A soft block stores 20h and queues tile 39h.
Write map byte 1 on cells that must stay empty during scattering.\nZ_49 0 marks 3 story cells. 1 also marks 3 mode-1 cells. 2 also marks 7 battle cells.
Mark the 3 mode-1 cells from MODE1_SEAL_COL/ROW with map byte 1.
Clear those 3 mode-1 cells back to map byte 0.
Mark the 7 battle cells from BATTLE_SEAL_COL/ROW with map byte 1.
Clear those 7 battle cells back to map byte 0.

Place bomb pickups on empty cells found by PLACE_ONE_PICKUP.\nZ_49 0: one bomb, flag W_04E3 with bit 7 set, plus one more soft block (map 22h).\nOtherwise 5 flags 80h and 5 flags 81h. Z_49 2 adds 5 flags 8Bh.
Find an empty cell, store map 21h, queue tile 39h, and fill one bomb slot.\nOut: X slot from FIND_FREE_BOMB, coords in W_04FA/W_0509. Increments W_04E2.
NMI off, upload the RLE nametable at column 20h (second screen on US), NMI on.\nJP starts at column 0. In: Z_20 RLE bytes, Z_24 64 attribute bytes.
US only. Same upload as DRAW_NAMETABLE_RLE_2 but from column 0, nametable 2000h.
US only. Save X/Y in W_0527/W_0528 and convert them with XY_TO_NT_ADDR.
Write 400h nametable bytes from Z_20, then 40h attribute bytes from Z_24.\nFF, count, tile repeats that tile count+1 times. Attributes also go to ATTR_BUF.
Point Z_20 at one stage layout.\nWhen Z_49 is 0, LAYOUT_VARIANT[area*8+stage] is 0 or 1 and is stored in W_04E1.\nIndex into STAGE_LAYOUT_PTR is area*2 plus that bit. 7 areas, 2 layouts each.
Area 0 metatile graphics. 4 CHR bytes per id. AREA_GFX_PTR[0].\nPAINT_LAYOUT_STRIP indexes this with the unpacked id times 4. Areas 1-6 follow the same layout.
Area 0 attributes. Two metatile ids per byte, low nibble first.\nPAINT_LAYOUT_STRIP shifts the id right once and takes the high nibble when carry is set. Value is 0-3.
Area 0 map byte per metatile id. COPY_LAYOUT_CELL reads (Z_64),Y with Y = the id.\nOne byte per id. The byte is what later collision code sees in the live map.
Area-card metatiles for area 0. Same 4-byte CHR layout as AREA0_META_GFX.\nS5_AD47 selects CARD0..CARD5 by Z_4B. CARD0_LAYOUT is the compressed picture.
Shared UI metatiles, 4 CHR bytes per id, 100h ids.\nUsed by the password, game-over, mode, win-count and pre-stage cards.\nUI_META_ATTR is 80h bytes (2 ids each). UI_META_MAP is one map byte per id.
Password-screen metatile CHR. S5_9365 points Z_62 here and Z_20 at PASSWORD_LAY.\nUS attributes start at PASS_META_ATTR. JP attributes start 3 bytes later.
Opening and ending metatile CHR. S5_B14A and S5_B1E6 both use this set.\nEND_META_ATTR holds 2-bit attributes. END_META_MAP holds one map byte per id.\nThe picture stream is OPENING_LAYOUT.

Compressed stage layout, area 0 variant A.
First 40h bytes are 32 word offsets added to this address by DECODE_LAYOUT.
Each strip is then bit-packed: a 1 bit takes the next byte as the metatile id, a 0 means id 0.
Variant B of the same area is the scrolling layout. See LAYOUT_VARIANT.
Compressed area-intro picture, area 0. Same strip format as AREA0_LAYOUT_A.\nS5_AD47 indexes CARD0_LAYOUT..CARD5_LAYOUT by Z_4B.
Title nametable RLE for the second screen on US (column 20h).\nUPLOAD_RLE_NAMETABLE reads it. FF starts a repeat. Title attributes are TITLE_ATTR, 40h bytes.

64 attribute bytes for both title nametable uploads.

48 bytes, one per stage: area 0-5 times stages 0-7. Each byte is 0 or 1.\nPICK_STAGE_LAYOUT stores it in W_04E1 and uses it to choose layout A or B.\nS5_8F6E later treats a nonzero W_04E1 as a horizontal scroll setup.
48 bytes, area*8+stage. Initial soft-block count for story mode.\nPLACE_SOFT_AND_BOMBS replaces it with 32h when Z_49 is not 0. The count is also copied to W_04E2.
14 words. Layout pointer for (area * 2 + variant). Areas 0-6, variant from LAYOUT_VARIANT.\nArea 6 uses AREA6_LAYOUT for both variants. Area 5 variant A is AREA5_LAYOUT_A inside the area-4 blob.
